analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 30.7, entering oversold territory, with 5 consecutive daily closes in the red indicating lack of buying pressure. ADX at 30.1 shows a clear trend, but +DI (11.8) is significantly lower than -DI (32.6), suggesting downward pressure dominance. Volume ratio at 0.78 of the 5-day average indicates contraction, lacking directional conviction. Price remains low at 10.6% of the 52-week high ($0.61), near the 52-week low ($0.14), but without clear reversal signals, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
